name: Ghost
summary: Publishing platform for blogs and newsletters on Docker with MySQL, with the owner account created at install.
notes: Ghost 6.72.0 (official image, tag and digest) with MySQL 8.4.13 (official image, tag and digest) behind Caddy. The owner is created through the Admin API during setup, so no first-visitor setup window exists. Outgoing mail is not configured, so staff device verification is turned off; configure a mail service in Ghost to enable newsletters and password reset. The owner email is a placeholder (owner@domain with a domain) that can be changed in Ghost settings.

licence.note: Ghost core and Admin MIT. MySQL Community Server is GPL-2.0 (with FOSS exception), run as an unmodified separate container. Caddy Apache-2.0. Docker Engine Apache-2.0. Official image bundles Node.js (MIT) and Alpine Linux.
